notices.name: no deprecation notices${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main' && ' (promotion)' || !(github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'develop') && format(' ({0})', github.event_name) || '' }}

steps.name: Take the check from the base commit
steps.run:
f=.github/scripts/ci/no-deprecation-notices.sh
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/judge"
listing="$(git -C base ls-tree --name-only HEAD -- "$f")" || exit 1
if [ -n "$listing" ]; then
  git -C base show "HEAD:$f" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/judge/no-deprecation-notices.sh" || exit 1
else
  echo "::notice::$f is not in the base commit; the copy of the change is used"
  cp "head/$f" "$RUNNER_TEMP/judge/no-deprecation-notices.sh"
fi
